stdout.meaning: Self-check emits raw plug receipt lines (id, title, parent, depth, contract, widget), or a raw hierarchy error or no-plugs diagnostic. Running the window has no JSON success receipt.

stderr.meaning: Usage, toolkit, or agathodaimon-gui-settings diagnostics; not an Alkahest refusal field.

mutationPerformed.meaning: An argument refused before the UI launched.

exceptionType.meaning: Type of an uncaught exception projected by the front door.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Named argument or unknown-plug refusal, or the front door's signal on an uncaught exception; not emitted by self-check.
